pipelineLocalStorageDescription: Loads images from disk from a designated folder
pipelineHotFolderDescription: Reads images from a designated hot folder.
pipelineGrouperNodeDescription: Groups images based on specified criteria.
pipelineArraySwitchNodeDescription: Switches between different arrays of images.
pipelineArrayAndNodeDescription: Combines arrays of images using AND logic.
pipelineArrayAndNotNodeDescription: Combines arrays of images using AND NOT logic.
pipelineArrayOrNodeDescription: Combines arrays of images using OR logic.
pipelineImagePickerDescription: Allows selection of a specific image from an array.
pipelineExifSplitNodeDescription: Splits images based on EXIF metadata.
pipelineGpsSplitNodeDescription: Splits images based on GPS metadata.
pipelineSplitChannelsNodeDescription: Splits each image into red, green, blue, and alpha channels.
pipelineMergeChannelsNodeDescription: Combines red, green, blue, and alpha channels into full images.
pipelineRotateDescription: Rotates the image by the specified amount of degrees.
pipelineExposureDescription: Adjusts the exposure of the image, making it brighter or darker.
pipelineBrightnessDescription: Adjusts the brightness of the image, making it lighter or darker.
pipelineContrastDescription: Adjusts the contrast of the image, making the darks darker and the lights lighter.
pipelineHighlightsDescription: Adjusts the highlights of the image, affecting the brighter areas.
pipelineShadowsDescription: Adjusts the shadows of the image, affecting the darker areas.
pipelineGammaDescription: Applies gamma correction to the image, affecting the midtones.
pipelineLuminosityDescription: Adjusts the overall luminosity of the image.
pipelineWhitesBlacksDescription: Adjusts the whites and blacks of the image, affecting the brightest and darkest areas.
pipelineRgbBlackPointDescription: Adjusts the black point of the RGB channels, affecting the darkest areas of the image.
pipelineRgbWhitePointDescription: Adjusts the white point of the RGB channels, affecting the brightest areas of the image.
pipelineRgbMidtonesDescription: Adjusts the midtones of the RGB channels, affecting the middle range of brightness in the image.
pipelineSaturationDescription: Adjusts the saturation of the image colors, enhancing or reducing the overall color vibrancy.
pipelineVibranceDescription: Enhances the vibrancy of the colors in the image while protecting skin tones from oversaturation.
pipelineHueRotationDescription: Rotates the hue of the image colors by the specified amount.
pipelineLutDescription: Applies a lookup table (LUT) to the image for color grading.
pipelineTemperatureTintDescription: Adjusts the temperature and tint of the image, allowing for color balance corrections.
pipelineSplitToningDescription: Applies split toning to the image, allowing separate color adjustments for shadows and highlights.
pipelineSharpenDescription: Sharpens the image by enhancing the edges and fine details.
pipelineAiDenoiserDescription: Reduces noise in the image using AI-based denoising algorithms.
pipelineGrainDescription: Adds grain to the image, simulating the texture of film photography.
pipelineVignetteDescription: Applies a vignette effect to the image, darkening the corners and edges.
pipelinePopDescription: Enhances the overall contrast and color vibrancy of the image.
pipelineHdrEffectDescription: Applies an HDR effect to the image, enhancing details in both shadows and highlights.
pipelineFadeDescription: Applies a fade effect to the image, reducing contrast and giving a washed-out look.
pipelineAiColorizerDescription: Automatically colorizes black and white images using AI.
pipelineAskAIDescription: Allows users to ask AI for assistance or information related to photo editing.
pipelinePhotosViewerDescription: Displays multiple photos in a viewer.
pipelinePhotoViewerDescription: Displays a single photo in a viewer.
pipelineExifViewerDescription: Displays the EXIF metadata of an image.
pipelineGpsMapDescription: Displays the GPS location of an image on a map.
pipelinePhotoHistogramDescription: Displays the histogram of an image.
pipelineHotFolderWriteDescription: Writes images to a designated hot folder.
